# ==== X: the extra list, in order of value. Units X1... are whole (a unit that ends the evening ends with the plain executable on the console); `restore` at the end puts the owner's np-player.txt back. The cumulative minutes are in CONSOLE-PLAN-r17.md
# ==== ON: the REAL online service (msc-online: strikers.psvita.dev first, the old address as the fallback), one console through the game's own menus, no opponent (online24; about 15 min; needs the executable with MSC_NET_REQLOG, i.e. a build that has agent/online24: without its `[np-net] req` lines the pass rules cannot be read and online_check.py says INVALID). Order: sign-in (new address first, then the old only), the two read-only lists, the quick and ranked queues (60 s wait, cancel), the report. The connection check (on-conn) is BY HAND: its only entry is the failure popup after a failed HOST A ROOM, so it needs a Wi-Fi with no internet (no np-player.txt line can fail the first try: the isolated reader refuses MSC_ONLINE_URL). Every run sets MSC_ONLINE_HOST=auto (on-hub-old: old) and MSC_ONLINE_NAME (a preset name: nothing is typed). The FIRST sign-in of the sitting makes the test account on the live service; the second on-hub run proves the stored token. Pass rules in the plan and in each run's why text; python3 tools/console-1.2/online_check.py <log> --run <id> applies them
run	on-hub	onhub	1.2	1.3
run	on-hub-old	onhub	1.2	1.3
run	on-lists	onlists	2.0	1.3
run	on-quick	onquick	2.7	1.3
run	on-ranked	onranked	3.0	1.3
run	on-report	settings	1.0	1.3
# ==== MP: multiplayer on ONE Vita (mp18, owner 23 Nov 'make sure multiplayer works'; about 13 min; today's plan, the fourth core on: needs CapUnlocker for the guard lines). A match needs a second device: w8/mp18.md. python3 tools/console-1.2/online_check.py <log> --run <id> applies the pass rules
